AnswerHold.title: AnswerHold
AnswerHold.description:
High-risk answers are verified before delivery; the UI shows
'Verifying…' with the trace live until the reviewed answer lands.

ReviewClaim.title: ReviewClaim
ReviewClaim.description: One claim's verification result (TRD §12 review.claim, slice 6).

Revision.title: Revision
Revision.description: The reviewer rewrote flagged claims (TRD §10, max one pass).

RunFilters.title: RunFilters
RunFilters.description:
Client filters on a run (TRD §12); every field can only narrow the
server-side ownership scope (TRD §9.2).

RunStreamResponse.title: RunStreamResponse
RunStreamResponse.description:
References the union so it lands in OpenAPI (TRD §12: the TS union is
generated from the schema, never hand-rolled).
